doctrine_note: REFINE pass (unblinded, price-bearing). Same engine as the blind, now with the price curve as causal evidence. The blind stays the CORE predictor; MBO/price is a POSTERIOR UPDATE (per-day weight_assigned emitted). g19 is a covering rally 2.750 -> ~3.13 against a record-extreme, still-worsening MM short (1y pctile 2.83 -> 0.94; MM_net -107k -> -120k; WoW -10,244 -> -12,576, both worsening). My blind post-mortem identified four fixes; all four are applied here WITH price. (1) DIRECTION is the per-phase flow_conviction = sign(sflow)*sign(pxchg) SIGN gate - NOT the big_print_b_share 0.55 arm, which never fired in this covering rally (max 0.537) yet the covering discharged full every owned day. (2) ABSORPTION IS A REVERSAL: absorbed SELL under flat/rising price -> UP; absorbed BUY under falling price -> DOWN - not a damp in the nominal flow direction. (3) The self-limiting 'spent' call is gated on the COT WoW DELTA: worsening WoW = live/recurring covering (size full, do not shave); only FLAT WoW = spent. All three owned days show worsening WoW, so the covering is honestly claimable at full size. (4) The covering-absorption UP tell flips to distribution-DOWN only at MAX extension (high cum-from-anchor + chain age >=5) AND ONLY when the absorption tell itself reverses; chain age alone does not flip it - on 0519 (chain age 7, cum 2770) the absorption was still firing UP and COT still worsening, so it stayed UP (the distribution DOWN landed the next day, 0520 seam, on buy-absorbed-under-falling - E's day).
cross_cutting_mbo_finding: The covering rally's direction is a PRICE-CONFIRMED per-phase absorption read, not a big-print-share threshold. The 0.55 big-print-buy arm I gated on in the blind NEVER fired (max big_print_b_share 0.537) yet the covering discharged in full on every owned day - 0513 flipped my highest-conviction down call to +420, 0519 discharged +840. The discriminator that actually fires is per-phase sign(sflow)*sign(pxchg): negative-under-rising = covering UP. Separately, the self-limiting 'this covering is spent, be small' instinct is refuted by the COT WoW delta, which stayed negative (worsening) all three owned days - the shorts were still ADDING into the rally they were being squeezed by, so the covering is live and recurring, not a spent tail to under-claim.

brain_proposals.name: core.flow_conviction_sign_gate
brain_proposals.rule: On price-bearing (refine) core days, DIRECTION per phase = sign(signed_flow)*sign(price_change). ALIGNED (>0) delivers the band in the flow direction; NEGATIVE (<0) = flow absorbed against price = covering/reversal in the PRICE direction. This sign gate REPLACES the big_print_b_share>=0.55 accumulation arm as the direction discriminator - the 0.55 arm is a blind proxy that fails to fire in genuine covering rallies (g19 max 0.537, covering fired full every day).
brain_proposals.scope: Refine pass, covering/absorption regimes and any absorb_session core day; the 0.55 arm remains a blind-only accumulation hint, not a sign gate.
brain_proposals.forward_evidence: g19 0513 (ph2 -1979/+400 flipped a down call to +420) and 0519 (ph2 -796/+650, ph3 -1549/+310 discharged +840); neither tripped the 0.55 arm.

brain_proposals.name: core.absorption_is_reversal
brain_proposals.rule: Absorption is a REVERSAL signal, not a damp in the nominal flow direction. Absorbed SELL under flat/rising price -> UP; absorbed BUY under falling price -> DOWN. Size to the covering/distribution move, not a throttled version of the aggressor-flow sign.
brain_proposals.scope: Any day with ph_absorb=true or absorb_session=true, both refine and (as a covering-flag) blind.
brain_proposals.forward_evidence: g19 0513 & 0519 absorbed-sell-under-rising -> UP (correct); cross-check 0520 seam absorbed-BUY-under-falling (ph2 +614/-850) -> DOWN (E's day, the distribution top).

brain_proposals.name: covering.self_limit_on_cot_wow_delta
brain_proposals.rule: A covering rally's 'spent' / self-limiting call is gated on the COT managed-money WoW DELTA, not on chain age or cum alone. Worsening WoW (net more negative = shorts still ADDING) = LIVE/recurring covering -> size full, do NOT shave to an 'honest under-claim' floor. Only a FLAT (or reversing-toward-zero) WoW delta licenses a 'spent' under-size.
brain_proposals.scope: Covering rallies against an extreme managed-money short; magnitude sizing on the covering-side days.
brain_proposals.forward_evidence: g19 all owned days WoW worsening (-10,244 then -12,576, pctile 2.83 -> 0.94) and the covering discharged full every day (0513 +420, 0519 +840); the blind's under-sizing was the mis-applied 'spent' instinct.

brain_proposals.name: covering.extension_distribution_flip
brain_proposals.rule: The covering-absorption UP tell flips to distribution-DOWN only when the rally is MAXIMALLY extended (high cum-from-anchor AND chain age >=5) AND the absorption tell itself reverses (aligned-down delivery, or big BUY absorbed under falling price). Extension (age/cum) alone does NOT flip the sign - while sell is still being absorbed under rising price and COT WoW is still worsening, the covering stays UP.
brain_proposals.scope: Mature covering rallies at/near their peak; the flip day is typically the roll-seam or first aligned-down-delivery session.
brain_proposals.forward_evidence: g19 0519 (chain age 7, cum 2770 = extension zone) STAYED UP (+840) because absorption still fired and COT still worsened; 0520 flipped DOWN (-1050) on buy-absorbed-under-falling - the distribution top.
